name: Elisara
summary: Elisara is upholstered in refined imitation leather that lends a smooth, polished character to its silhouette. The design is elevated on stainless steel legs finished in brushed nickel, a subtle detail that adds modern radiance. With its clean lines and poised form, it embodies understated elegance made to enhance contemporary interiors with quiet distinction. 62x60x72
